rows.claim: The old %W-%w format used Monday-based week numbering that isn't ISO.
rows.evidence: No tool output demonstrates how %W-%w behaves. The agent only saw the source code. The claim rests on background knowledge (%W is Monday-based week of year, not ISO), not on anything shown in the run.

After the fix, pytest reported 6 passed with only two other tests failing (test_holidays_are_informational and test_week_one_starts_on_first_monday). test_midweek, which asserts parse_iso_week('2026-W05-3') == date(2026,1,28), was not among the failures, so it passed.
